about: Live eval of the Alexa brain (Claude Haiku + skills/shop-counter/SKILL.md) through apps/echo-sim/server/brain.mjs and the real Shop Counter MCP server. Each scenario is a conversation: turns the shopper says, what the model must (tools) and must not (toolsNot) call, and what its spoken line must (say) or must not (sayNot) contain. Global checks run on every turn: spoken dollar amounts vs tool data, compatibility claims vs status, no invented policy, place_order only after a clear yes, 1-2 short sentences, no 'which model?' when the closet knows. `setup` = MCP calls made before the conversation (state the model does not see). `newSession` = new login of the same shopper, new MCP connection, empty history. Runner: evals/llm_run.mjs.

scenarios.trap: full video flow: closet, search, compatibility from the closet, two-step order, status in a new session
